intro.speaker: guide
intro.text: Hello, {player}! Welcome to the [c=title]Dev Engine[/c].[p=300] This box is the new dialog system.

intro: Lines come from [c=accent]assets/dialog/demo.json[/c], compiled to a small binary bank at build time.

Text wraps by itself, and a long line is split into pages. Colours, [c=hilite]highlights[/c] and [c=dim]quiet asides[/c] come from the UI style,[p=250] so every style gets them for free.[page]This is a forced page break. The game fills in variables too: you are running at {fps} FPS in the {style} style.

intro.text: What would you like to see?
Here it comes![p=400] Watch the platform.

intro.speaker: you
intro.text: Nice. Can I ask something else?

intro: Open the Debug tab and pick Dialog to come back.

howto.speaker: guide
howto.text: Each conversation is a list of lines. A line can name a speaker, fire an [c=accent]event[/c], and offer up to four [c=accent]choices[/c].

howto: Choices can hide behind a condition the game answers, like whether the ball exists yet.
Mistakes such as a missing target fail the build with the file and line position, so they never reach the cartridge.
